# Verification Checklist Template

## Static

- `npm run lint`
- `npm run build`

## Functional

- Main happy path
- Empty state
- Error state
- Recovery path

## UX

- Desktop check
- Mobile check
- Copy consistency
- CTA behavior

## Operational

- Missing env behavior
- Auth or permission behavior
- Rollback or safe-failure behavior

## Evidence

- Note what was actually run
- Note what was intentionally skipped and why
